title: Detailed star
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='starGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE94A'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFC107'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF9800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='innerGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDE7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE082'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow halo -->
  <polygon points='50,6 61,35 92,35 67,54 77,85 50,66 23,85 33,54 8,35 39,35'
           fill='#FF8F00' opacity='0.25' transform='translate(50,50) scale(1.18) translate(-50,-50)'/>

  <!-- main star body -->
  <polygon points='50,8 61.5,37 93,37 67,56.5 77.5,86 50,67 22.5,86 33,56.5 7,37 38.5,37'
           fill='url(#starGrad)'/>

  <!-- facet highlights on star points -->
  <polygon points='50,8 61.5,37 50,30' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.6'/>
  <polygon points='93,37 67,56.5 78,45' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.5'/>
  <polygon points='7,37 33,56.5 22,45' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- inner star face area -->
  <polygon points='50,24 57,41 75,41 61,51.5 66.5,69 50,58.5 33.5,69 39,51.5 25,41 43,41'
           fill='url(#innerGrad)' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- cute eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='49' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3E2723'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='49' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3E2723'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <ellipse cx='40.5' cy='47' rx='2' ry='2.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='56.5' cy='47' rx='2' ry='2.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- tiny secondary shines -->
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='51' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='51' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- cute smile -->
  <path d='M43,58 Q50,66 57,58' stroke='#3E2723' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='56' rx='4' ry='2.8' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='56' rx='4' ry='2.8' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- sparkle accents -->
  <line x1='20' y1='20' x2='24' y2='24' stroke='#FFFDE7' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='24' x2='24' y2='20' stroke='#FFFDE7' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='18' x2='80' y2='22' stroke='#FFFDE7' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <line x1='78' y1='22' x2='80' y2='18' stroke='#FFFDE7' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <line x1='85' y1='70' x2='88' y2='73' stroke='#FFFDE7' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='12' y1='68' x2='15' y2='71' stroke='#FFFDE7' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='12' r='1.5' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='10' r='1.2' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='52' r='1.3' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='52' r='1.3' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
